BIM Pro

Spend Less Time Managing Revit, and More Time Designing.

BIM Pro is a Revit productivity add-in designed to automate repetitive BIM and structural documentation tasks while keeping users working directly inside Revit.

Built for Revit Productivity

BIM Pro provides practical tools for structural, architectural, engineering, and BIM professionals who want to reduce repetitive tasks and improve consistency within their Revit workflow.

Supports Revit 2024, 2025, 2026 & 2027

Features

Workset Memory

Save and restore workset configurations for faster project setup and management.

Save & Restore Sessions

Save and restore Revit working-session settings.

PDF/DWG Sheet Export

Streamline PDF and DWG sheet export workflows.

Pile Coordinates

Process and manage pile coordinate information and numbering.

Excel → Revit

Transfer tabular information from Excel into Revit.

Revit Schedule → Excel

Export Revit schedule information to Excel.

Purge Imported Linetypes

Remove unnecessary imported linetypes from Revit projects.

Protected Synchronization

Administrative controls for controlled synchronization workflows.
